title: The content-addressed file store and the file records
spec: FileStore keeps bytes under files/<2 hex>/<64 hex SHA-256>, owner-only; uploads in progress are files/partial/<id>, written at offsets in any order, never served, removed when the store opens. finish checks the declared size and SHA-256 (WrongSize, WrongHash), syncs, and renames into place, or drops the partial when those bytes are already stored; the partial is gone either way. read returns a byte range; sweep removes content files no record refers to, leaving anything that is not a content name. image_size reads width and height from PNG, GIF, JPEG (first start-of-frame marker, skipping others) and WebP (VP8X, VP8L, VP8) headers; None otherwise or for a zero dimension. Op::FileStored (tag 8) records room, uploader, file id, SHA-256, size, name and image size; DurableServer::record_file refuses a non-member (NotMember), a bad name (BadName: empty, over 255 bytes, . or .., a slash, backslash or control character), a size of 0 (Empty) and a reused id (DuplicateId); file() and referenced_hashes() read the records, which survive a replay.
